name: Credential Theft via Mimikatz
description: An attacker has gained initial access through a phishing email and is now attempting to dump credentials from LSASS memory using Mimikatz. The stolen credentials may be used for lateral movement.
objective: Detect the credential dumping activity, identify compromised accounts, and prevent lateral movement using the stolen credentials.

events.message: Process lsass.exe accessed by mimikatz.exe (PID 4892) - credential dump attempt
Pass-the-hash attempt: Domain admin login from workstation-FIN-03 using NTLM hash (no password entered)
SMB lateral movement: 10.0.2.41 -> 10.0.1.5 (dc-server-01) - admin$ share accessed

hints: LSASS process access by non-system processes is a red flag
Look for credential files created in temp directories
Pass-the-hash attacks bypass normal password authentication
Disable the compromised domain admin account immediately
